record.title: Greece restricts passenger admission from Albania and North Macedonia during the pandemic
record.scope: Inward road and rail admission at Albania and North Macedonia frontiers; other modes in the order excluded from this record
record.crossings: Albania and North Macedonia frontiers; endpoint covers Evzoni–Bogorodica only
record.movement: Non-exempt passengers arriving from Albania and North Macedonia
record.exceptions: Greek citizens, qualifying residence/main domicile and, for Albania, ethnic-Greek identity-card holders; freight trucks. Later essential work/medical and other category exceptions.
record.imposing_authority: Greek Government; border and customs authorities
record.enforcement: Joint ministerial decision; government confirmed essential-only crossings in July; AMNA reported Evzoni reopening in May 2021.
record.consequences: Ordinary cross-border passenger journeys restricted; freight exceptions maintained.
record.relationship: Greek-imposed restriction is distinct from Albania EU021 and North Macedonia EU020, which concern the opposite authorities and directions.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Protect public health and limit COVID-19 transmission.
record.context: Initial bilateral-frontier restrictions continued through later entry regimes. May 2021 tourism easing admitted eligible North Macedonia residents through Evzoni.
record.uncertainty: Start is legal commencement at 15:00, not first rejection observed. The May endpoint is Evzoni partial reopening; it does not end the Albanian-frontier restriction or establish all intermediate renewals. Nationality wording in news is narrower than the formal resident-based permission; legal scope governs.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. No numerical duration: two frontiers, changing admission categories and an Evzoni-only endpoint.

followup_reviews.Research finding: The Greek admission rules are supported. Retain formal-policy classification; do not upgrade the phase to a complete operational closure. The parent describes Greek-imposed inward road/rail restrictions at Albania and North Macedonia. The selected endpoint covers eligible North Macedonian visitors through Evzoni only, with Greek/resident, essential and freight exceptions. The initial Gazette starts 15 March 2020 at 15:00. The May rule starts 14 May 2021 at 06:00; reported Evzoni service is 14:00. Retain the selected 425-calendar-day policy segment with incomplete intermediate-instrument and daily-enforcement reconstruction disclosed. Human disease control is explicit in the initial public-health decision. No inference of a new security or migration rationale is made. Both Gazette PDFs, the July government briefing and AMNA reporting through Naftemporiki were directly read in Greek. Text passages were inspected; no PDF visual inspection or human translation is claimed. The selected policy phase remains unlocated and outside the observed-operation display rule. Evzoni’s conditional endpoint cannot reopen Niki, Doirani or Albanian posts by inference.
